title: Moon: Artemis Frontier
description: Design lunar orbiters and robotic polar prospectors to discover water ice hidden in permanently shadowed craters at the Moon's South Pole.

missions.title: Lunar Reconnaissance & Mineral Mapping
missions.description: Select launch rocket, 3D stereo imager, and solar power bus to map the sunlit lunar plains and crater topography.

tasks.label: Map 3D crater elevation profiles
Achieve stable polar observation orbit
Maintain ≥ 20% power reserve in eclipse

missions.title: Polar Crater Water-Ice Prospecting
missions.description: Equip high-energy neutron spectrometer and thermal insulation blankets to survey hydrogen anomalies inside Shackleton Crater.

tasks.label: Detect hydrogen signatures in cold traps
Install thermal heaters for -200°C shadows
Maintain continuous Earth communication

missions.title: South Pole Autonomous Hopper
missions.description: Configure propulsion mass and high-capacity dual batteries to hop across rugged ridges and explore multiple lunar craters.

tasks.label: Execute multi-site landing sequence
Transmit surface radar sounding profiles
Reserve 25% thruster margin for return hop

missions.title: Far Side Subsurface Radar Survey
missions.description: Deploy deep-penetrating radar sounder to map buried basalt flows and crustal layering on the radio-quiet lunar far side.

tasks.label: Acquire subsurface radar echoes to 10m depth
Use Ka-band relay link through halo orbiter
Balance radar power draw with battery storage

missions.title: Lunar Gateway Communications Network
missions.description: Establish a high-throughput deep-space optical transceiver network in near-rectilinear halo orbit connecting Moon and Earth.

tasks.label: Deploy optical laser transceiver
Sustain gigabit downlink bandwidth
Ensure continuous power via deployable wings

title: Mars: Red Planet Odyssey
description: Fly across 200 million kilometers of deep space, brave Martian dust storms, execute daring aerobraking passes, and search for ancient microbial biosignatures.

missions.title: Atmospheric Aerobraker & Dust Monitor
missions.description: Skim Mars's upper atmosphere using ceramic thermal shielding to circularize orbit without heavy fuel burn.

tasks.label: Survive 400 aerobraking friction passes
Sample escaping atmospheric argon and CO2
Maintain thermal balance during solar flares

missions.title: Gale Crater Ancient Lakebed Rover
missions.description: Equip MMRTG nuclear power to withstand freezing nights and global dust storms while exploring clay-rich lakebed strata.

tasks.label: Power continuous driving through dust storms
Identify hydrated clay minerals with spectrometer
High-gain downlink to NASA Deep Space Network

missions.title: Subsurface Glacial Radar Sounder
missions.description: Map buried pure water-ice sheets across Utopia Planitia to identify landing sites for future human exploration.

tasks.label: Sound underground ice deposits to 50m depth
Transmit multi-gigabyte radar profiles home
Maintain positive power at Mars solar distance

missions.title: Phobos & Deimos High-Res Survey
missions.description: Perform close-proximity flybys of Mars's captured asteroid moons to inspect surface regolith and crater monoliths.

tasks.label: Map Phobos Stickney Crater at 20cm resolution
Measure surface gravity and regolith density
Execute micro-thruster rendezvous burns

missions.title: Interplanetary Sample Return Carrier
missions.description: Intercept the Mars Ascent Vehicle in low Martian orbit, capture sealed rock core tubes, and fire the trans-Earth injection burn.

tasks.label: Autonomous rendezvous with orbiting sample container
Deep-space laser telemetry to Earth receiving dish
Execute escape velocity injection within fuel budget

title: Earth: Climate Sentinel
description: Design remote-sensing Earth observatories to measure global ice-sheet melting rates, monitor wildfire smoke plumes, and track greenhouse gas concentrations.

missions.title: Polar Ice Cap Elevation Altimetry
missions.description: Launch into Sun-Synchronous Orbit with a precision laser altimeter to measure Greenland and Antarctic ice sheet thickness variations.

tasks.label: Achieve 98.2° Sun-Synchronous Orbit
Measure polar ice sheet elevation changes
Maintain continuous power in near-constant sunlight

missions.title: Ocean Salinity & Sea Surface Radar
missions.description: Equip synthetic aperture radar to map global sea surface heights, ocean currents, and hurricane wind speeds.

tasks.label: Acquire global ocean surface radar topography
Downlink high-bandwidth oceanographic data
Buffer power during 36-minute eclipse passes

missions.title: Greenhouse Gas & Methane Plume Lidar
missions.description: Deploy hyperspectral spectrometer to identify point-source methane leaks from industrial facilities and natural wetlands.

tasks.label: Isolate atmospheric methane absorption bands
Direct optical downlink to international weather hubs
Provide 100W peak power for spectrometer cryocooler

missions.title: Disaster Rapid Response Constellation
missions.description: Deploy a compact CubeSat bus equipped with optical stereo imaging to transmit real-time wildfire and flood imagery to first responders.

tasks.label: Lightweight bus for rapid launcher deployment
Rapid stereo mapping of emergency disaster zones
Low-latency emergency transmission via omni link

missions.title: Global Biosphere Sentinel
missions.description: Continuous multi-spectral monitoring of rainforest deforestation, agricultural crop yields, and ocean phytoplankton blooms.

tasks.label: Full terrestrial vegetation index coverage
High-speed Ka-band downlink to ground network
Design for 5-year extended orbital lifespan
